nom: NATASHA DENONA Hy-Gen Energizing & Hydrating Primer Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin most often praise the serum's hydration, several saying it replaces a separate moisturizer or facial oil entirely.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea or dermatitis, generally report no irritation or breakouts, describing it as soothing.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it balances their T-zone while still hydrating drier areas and works well mixed into foundation.
segments.oily: A couple of reviewers with oily skin say it helps manage shine and balance an oily T-zone rather than adding to it.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature, including one managing an autoimmune condition that has aged her skin faster, report a luminous, youthful-looking finish without needing foundation.

concerns.dehydration: Nearly every reviewer, including many with dry or dehydrated skin, describes the serum as strongly hydrating and glow-giving, often replacing a separate moisturizer entirely; effects are described as immediate and lasting through the day.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin generally say it balances an oily T-zone rather than adding shine, though a few with drier skin found the initial texture tackier or heavier than expected before it set.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers, including one with rosacea and one managing dermatitis, report no irritation from the serum; one reviewer notes a brief flush immediately after application that faded quickly.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers across skin types mention the serum did not cause breakouts over multiple weeks of use, though this is a secondary observation rather than the product's main focus.

aspects.libelle: Visible shimmer can look glittery up close
Dropper doesn't always draw product reliably
Makeup applies smoother and lasts longer over it
Pricey but a little goes a long way

extraits.texte: I bought this really hoping it would work for me. I do not have oily or dry skin. I used it twice and haven't used it again. I tried it once with Clinique tinted moisturizer. And once with my tarte foundation. I only used a tiny bit each time because a little goes along way. It did not look good on me. Both times trying the product I had to wash it off my face. I swear by the two-faced plump and prime. I am so glad they came out with one that works for me. It does look amazing on the lady in the photo on one of these reviews. It might just be my skin type. I don't think it would work for someone who has a skin type like mine that is neither Oily or dry

extraits.titre: Perfect Shimmer for a Healthy Looking Glow
extraits.texte: I've only been using this product for a few days, but so far I'm loving it! To preface, I have combination skin, but definitely more dry than oily. This product is not only hydrating but it doesn't feel heavy on my skin, making me feel oily. It initially leaves a slight sticky texture, which makes it perfect for its intent to act as a primer. It has shimmer, so you'll definitely feel like you're glowing. I haven't had any kind of reaction to it, and having sensitive skin, this is a huge win. My one issue with it is the scent. It has a pretty strong smell leaning towards floral, and I'm just not someone who enjoys scent in a product targeted for skincare. Once it settles into my skin, the smell goes away.

extraits.titre: Works as a reliable primer under makeup
extraits.texte: I just recently got this serum/primer. The consistency turned out to be more oily than I expected, but once it absorbs, it leaves a film that creates a great base for makeup. I have dry, sensitive skin, so this kind of texture is unusual for me. The shimmer has a lovely tone and creates a natural glow — you can see it in the swatch photo on my hand.

I have very sensitive skin with rosacea and it's hard for me to find products that don't irritate my skin. This primer is pure magic. It is so soothing and beautiful. My makeup looks flawless and poreless and it stays on all day thanks to this amazing primer. This is the best primer I have ever tried and trust I tried ALOT!

This product blew all my expectations out of the water. I have to be picky on what products I use since I have an autoimmune disease which has made my skin age quicker. Full coverage products don't mesh well. THIS product however has made it into my permanent lineup. First off the packaging is very luxurious and quality feeling. The coloring of the product might throw you off and make you think you'll end up looking like Edward from Twilight..Do not panic.. It blends into one of the most beautiful,luminous, hydrating products you can put on your face. I used this many times before putting a review because I was shocked at how well it worked. I didn't have to use any foundation because it made my skin look AMAZING. The rest of my makeup stayed beautifully on my skin the entire day. For having mature like skin, this made me look and feel more youthful. It says use a few drops but I have a big face and just used the entire dropper. Well worth the price. Quality is unmatched. I can see this working well for so many different people. For those who like lightweight makeup and natural finishes to those that like a full glam I think this would be beautiful for everyone.

extraits.titre: A nice, hydrating 2 for 1 serum & primer
extraits.texte: I received this product for free to test from BzzAgent and I'm so glad I did. I'm 41 and my skin has changed to extremely sensitive and dry. I've tried so many different skincare products to bring the youthful glow back but I always end up destroying my skin barrier when I introduce something new. I love that I was able to use this as a serum on its own as well as a primer under makeup. The serum gives a nice, highlighted glow rather than a greasy sheen like some other dewy products I've tried. I didn't have any burning or negative effects. When I used this as a primer, it made my makeup go on smoothly and my "every day" look stayed put. I haven't tried with heavier makeup so I'm unsure of longterm wear with that. Overall, it's a solid item to have in your arsenal, but whether there are better products at a cheaper price point is probably debatable.

This primer serum really is hydrating. It absorbs into my skin almost instantly, and you can feel that your skin is actually hydrated and the feeling lasts! It has almost the sparkle to it and gives you this light glow, which is really pretty! The serum is lightweight and works really well under my makeup. I've been using it in the mornings because it makes my skin look refreshed. I was also pleasantly surprised that it does help manage my oil consistency throughout the day. I typically have really oily skin. I noticed it's not as bad when I am wearing this! Especially now that it is summertime!
